study type: Mixed methods: Randomized controlled trial, population-based observational study, and register-based cohort study
exposure: Causes of severe PPH (atony, abnormal invasive placenta, retained placenta)
Duration of the third stage of labour
outcome: Need for red blood cell transfusion at 6 weeks postpartum
Fresh frozen plasma to red blood cell ratio
Number of red blood cells before first platelet transfusion
cohort: The thesis includes three cohorts: 249 women with severe PPH, 245 women receiving massive blood transfusions due to PPH, and 43,357 women with vaginal deliveries.
finding: The thesis found that preemptive fibrinogen did not reduce postpartum blood transfusions, that massive PPH was mainly caused by atony and abnormal invasive placenta, and that retained placenta was a strong predictor of blood loss in vaginal deliveries, with PPH causes varying by diagnostic cut-off.
